notes: The critic in action, ThrusterChain: version 5 of the importance-weighting experiment, TD3+BC hosts of data seed 0, one start (index 1) of each start bank, the host's own actor driving 100 steps.

eps: one array per (quality, critic, situation) in the order of 'fields'. push: c + w1 per state. pos: the five floats' position numbers. cmd: the actor's four throttles (negative = upstream). reward: per state. q_actor, qpi_actor: Q(s, a) = min(Q1, Q2) and Q^pi(s, a) at the actor's own command (7 significant digits).

q_sweep, qpi_sweep: per state, the 41 swept thruster-1 throttles u (upstream %, thrusters 2-4 at the actor's command) as integers in millionths relative to the value at the actor's command: r_0, r_1 - r_0, then second differences. Sum twice to get r_k; value_k = (round(1e6 actor value) + r_k) / 1e6, exactly the 7-significant-digit value.

a_hat, a_best_true: indices into u of the critic's highest-rated swept throttle and of the swept throttle with the highest Q^pi (computed at full precision). slice: [low, high] upstream share (0-1) in which the swept command lies inside the removed ball, or null. actor_in_ball: 1 if the actor's command lies inside it.

summ, ctx: per-episode statistics and the first-ten-starts comparison, 4 significant digits; notes in summary_notes. Points: 100 (J - J_random) / (J_stall_aware - J_random) with the start bank's mean anchors.

summary_notes.actor_thruster1_past80_steps: steps (of 100) at which the actor commanded thruster 1 past 80% upstream
summary_notes.actor_any_thruster_past80_steps: steps at which the actor commanded any thruster past 80%
summary_notes.a_hat_past80_states: states at which the swept command the critic rates highest (a-hat) is past 80%
summary_notes.a_hat_at_80_states: states at which a-hat is exactly 80%
summary_notes.best_true_past80_states: states at which the swept command with the highest true value Q^pi is past 80%
summary_notes.best_true_at_80_states: states at which the swept command with the highest Q^pi is exactly 80%
summary_notes.critic_higher_at_100_than_80_states: states at which the critic's Q at 100% is above its Q at 80%
summary_notes.critic_keeps_rising_80_to_100_states: states at which the critic's Q rises at every sweep step from 80% to 100%
summary_notes.truth_lower_at_100_than_80_states: states at which Q^pi at 100% is below Q^pi at 80%
summary_notes.truth_keeps_falling_80_to_100_states: states at which Q^pi falls at every sweep step from 80% to 100%
summary_notes.critic_rises_while_truth_falls_states: states at which the critic's Q is higher at 100% than at 80% while Q^pi is lower
summary_notes.critic_rises_while_truth_falls_steps: the steps t (0-99) of those states
summary_notes.critic_change_80_to_100_mean: mean over states of Q(100%) - Q(80%)
summary_notes.truth_change_80_to_100_mean: mean over states of Q^pi(100%) - Q^pi(80%)
summary_notes.critic_change_80_to_100_where_truth_fall: mean of Q(100%) - Q(80%) over the states where the critic rises while the truth falls
summary_notes.truth_change_80_to_100_where_critic_rise: mean of Q^pi(100%) - Q^pi(80%) over the same states
summary_notes.over_preference_100_vs_80_mean: mean over states of [Q(100%) - Q(80%)] - [Q^pi(100%) - Q^pi(80%)]: how much more the critic prefers 100% over 80% than the truth does
summary_notes.over_preference_100_vs_80_max: its largest value over the states
summary_notes.true_cost_of_a_hat_mean: mean over states of Q^pi(best swept command) - Q^pi(a-hat): the true value lost by taking the critic's top-rated thruster-1 command instead of the truly best one
summary_notes.critic_minus_truth_at_actor_command_mean: mean over states of Q - Q^pi at the actor's own command (the critic's level error)
summary_notes.push_mean_where_critic_rises_while_truth: mean water push c + w1 at those states
summary_notes.push_mean_elsewhere: mean water push c + w1 at the other states

meta.start_rule: the first start whose current lies inside the interquartile range of its own mix, in both mixes (the banks share one uniform draw per start, so it is one index)
